verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a plugin ecosystem used inside Codex and ChatGPT, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, or any opt-out setting. The only privacy-adjacent item describes what Sign in with ChatGPT shares with partners, which is a different control, not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
